description:
Read a CraterView.ai job: the result of one that had not finished, or fresh links to one that has.

Call this when a tool that runs a job returned a status of queued or running. It waits up to 25 seconds for the job to finish before answering, so there is no need to pause between calls: if it answers that the job is still queued or running, call it again.

`flagged`: Whether an automated check thought this job's images may fall outside what the service allows: the part of your image the job worked on and, for some jobs, the result. A flag does not stop the job: it runs, is charged and returns as usual. `null` means they were not all checked.

job_id.description: The job's `id`, from the tool that ran it or list_jobs.

name: get_job
